entries.599015189919a884: As a specialist in natural foods that do not use unnecessary food additives, it has built a history of more than 55 years. Group-brand products are manufactured under a system of entrusting manufacturers able to meet the company's own quality control standards, with raw materials and specifications designated by the company, and the company also conducts voluntary testing for radioactive substances and allergens at external food analysis specialist institutions. It holds brands such as Benibana Ichiban, Jirorōmōni and Meishī-chan, and product development is handled by the Product Development Department of the Products Headquarters.

entries.72cfd7badf59f149: In the food industry, demand from the restaurant and tourism industries shows signs of a gradual recovery, while rising consumer frugality due to higher prices, labor shortages and logistics issues have led to a polarization between small and mid-sized companies and large companies, and the operating environment remains difficult. The natural food market continues to expand, while new entrants are said to be numerous. Within this environment, the company operates in a single segment, wholesale of health and natural foods, and its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,751 million.

entries.baee97087d886eef: This is the company group's only business, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary (Takahashi Seimen Co., Ltd.), two companies in total. It manufactures and sells a wide range of foods that pursue safety and nutritional value, and its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,751 million. The company plans, develops and sells foods that are “safe,” “delicious” and “nutritionally valuable,” while Takahashi Seimen Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing instant noodles. Its head office is in Kanagawa Ward, Yokohama City, and the consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 38. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
